edges.reason: block.timestamp drives the limited office-hours modifier gating execute().
nextCastTime derives day/hour/minute/second from block.timestamp.
Constructor computes expiration from block.timestamp + 30 days.
schedule() uses now/block.timestamp to set eta and check expiration.
_description parameter is stored into the description state variable.
_expiration parameter is stored into the expiration state variable.
_spellAction parameter is stored into the action state variable.
Constructor resolves the pause proxy from the changelog into pause.
Constructor computes the extcodehash tag stored in tag.
Constructor encodes execute() signature into sig.
Constructor performs inline assembly extcodehash on the action address.
DssSpell constructor deploys the DssSpellAction into action_.
DssSpell constructor invokes the DssExec constructor with action parameters.
schedule() forwards the spell to the pause proxy via plot().
cast() forwards the spell to the pause proxy via exec().
External exec() on the pause proxy invokes the spell action and could re-enter cast().
execute() dispatches to the virtual actions() payload.
DssSpellAction.actions() overrides DssAction.actions().
limited modifier calls officeHours() before running execute().
nextCastTime consults the action's officeHours() setting.
actions() calls addNewCollateral() to onboard ETH-C.
actions() performs external library calls mutating the Maker system.
actions() reads MCD_JOIN_ETH_C when building the ETH-C options.
actions() reads MCD_FLIP_ETH_C when building the ETH-C options.
actions() populates the local ETH_C CollateralOpts struct.
The ETH_C struct is passed into addNewCollateral().
addNewCollateral consumes the CollateralOpts parameter co.
castTime local is computed and returned by nextCastTime.
day local is derived inside nextCastTime.
hour local is derived inside nextCastTime.
minute local is derived inside nextCastTime.
second local is derived inside nextCastTime.
cast() reads and sets the done flag guarding against double execution.
schedule() writes eta computed from now + pause delay.
nextCastTime reads eta as the earliest castable time.
plot() is called with eta as the scheduled execution timestamp.
setChangelogAddress is invoked with MCD_JOIN_ETH_C.
setChangelogAddress is invoked with MCD_FLIP_ETH_C.

normalization_plan.reason: Constructor parameter _description only feeds the DssExec constructor state assignment.
Constructor parameter _expiration only feeds the DssExec constructor state assignment.
Constructor parameter _spellAction only feeds the DssExec constructor state assignment.
CollateralOpts parameter co is consumed solely by addNewCollateral.
Local castTime exists only inside nextCastTime.
Local day exists only inside nextCastTime.
Local hour exists only inside nextCastTime.
Local minute exists only inside nextCastTime.
Local second exists only inside nextCastTime.
Local ETH_C struct is built and used only within DssSpellAction.actions.
